title: LAN Family Dayboard
user: A household that wants a shared tablet or e-ink display for today's events and responsibilities without creating cloud accounts for every family member.
smallest_useful_product: Static web dayboard that reads manually imported ICS files or a user-run LAN feed, renders a big today/tomorrow view and chores, and prints a weekly sheet.
constraints: Parse ICS locally and safely; never scrape third-party calendars or store credentials; provide a clear manual-refresh path for offline displays.
success_measure: In a two-week household trial, participants consult the display on at least ten days and report fewer than two missed shared events attributable to calendar visibility.
